content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone have suggestions regarding this issue? I created a custom website on one computer, and it works fine there. However, when trying to access the site from another computer or smartphone, I only see a blank page without any navigation tools. The device is connected to the same network, and I can successfully ping it. Any ideas would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!

This thread is closed because the question was asked in another post. The duplicate topic, 'Web Editor - switch off customized web site', is available within the relevant software conference. Kind regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports that after building a custom website using [product_name], the site works on the original development computer but appears blank when accessed from other devices on the same network, despite successful network connectivity. This points to a configuration, deployment, or permissions issue affecting the accessibility of the site across different devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the custom site built with [product_name] to be accessible and operate correctly from any device within the network, not just the computer used for development.
